title: Evidence-assembly terminal binding (retained audit record)
description: appsec-review/evidence-assembly-terminal-binding/1.0: terminal-binding.json in a 02-evidence-assembly attempt. Records the C01/C02 producer-binding generation that verified this assembly: the copied terminal-instances.json (path, file hash, its manifest_sha256, outcome, counts), the hash of the full pool specification and each producer's claimed instance ids. It names the content manifest it accompanies by manifest_sha256; the manifest names it by path only, so a re-run generation with new instance ids never changes the manifest or the reuse fingerprint. The assembly envelope hash-binds this file and validation re-derives it from the recorded pool.
